messages:
Cara - Eng Sec: Heads-up: dependabot flagged CVE-2026-4821 in pycrypto. Public PoC popped up on GH. Affects hosted inference workers and our on-prem packaging. Need to decide priority and schedule. SLA/customer tier impact?

Ben - Infra: Can you paste the link + short repro? My current read: pycrypto used only by legacy keywrap in installer for on-prem, but hosted worker image includes it in a helper lib. If PoC triggers remote key stuff that's bad.

Cara - Eng Sec: Link: https://github.com/example/poc-CVE-2026-4821
Cara - Eng Sec: Quick excerpt: PoC uses AES keywrap fallback -> unauth remote decryption. Not arbitrary code exec in worker, but can leak keys if attacker can trigger wrap/unwrap.

security-bot: CVE-2026-4821 | CVSS 7.2 (HIGH) | Vector: AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:C/C:H/I:N/A:N | References: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-4821

Dave - Eng Runtime: If it's keywrap leakage then hosted API customers who use our managed key rotation could be at risk. Dedicated/private customers who manage KMS likely unaffected unless they use legacy keywrap path.

Alice - SecOps: Recommend: 1) Hosted: emergency patch within 48h + canary rollout to 10% traffic. 2) Dedicated: push patch to reserved GPU nodes in next maintenance window (7 days) unless customer reports usage of old keywrap. 3) Private/on-prem: issue advisory and provide patch/backport; offer assist with urgent customers.

Emily - Product: +1 on triage. We should prioritize notifying high-tier (Enterprise & Dedicated) customers immediately with guidance, but only public advisory if exploitability confirmed. Can comms draft ops help?

Frank - Customer Success: I'll prep a targeted note for customers with Dedicated contracts and any on-prem installs we know about. Need wording: whether to rotate customer KMS keys or temporarily disable feature.

Ben - Infra: Technical plan: replace pycrypto with pyca/cryptography where possible and remove legacy keywrap shim. Temp mitigation: add feature-flag to disable legacy keywrap and rebuild images. Canary plan: roll new image to canary cluster, monitor error/latency for 4 hours, then 10% -> 50% -> 100%.

Cara - Eng Sec: Timeline proposal: patch branch today, internal review tonight, canary deploy tomorrow morning UTC 07:00; full roll within 48h if canary clean. Private builds + advisory within 14 days with backports.

Dave - Eng Runtime: Risk: need to ensure KV cache and session tokens unaffected by rebuild. I want integration smoke: generate requests that exercise keywrap API in CI. I'll add tests to ensure no regression.

Alice - SecOps: Notify legal for customer notice wording and get approval on disclosure timing. Also create incident ticket and set severity HIGH given public PoC.

Cara - Eng Sec: Assigning tasks: @Ben to implement swap/remove pycrypto (ticket INF-5781), @Dave add CI smoke tests (ticket RT-3090), @Alice own advisory + legal (ticket SEC-4321), @Frank customer outreach list. I'll track in triage board.

Frank - Customer Success: Got it. I'll ping top 10 enterprise contacts now and include instructions: rotate KMS keys and disable legacy feature if possible.

Emily - Product: We should prepare a short public post if exploitability confirmed post-canary. For now, controlled outreach only.

Ben - Infra: Quick mitigation snippet for ops patch (for internal use):
```
# temp disable legacy keywrap
sed -i 's/ENABLE_LEGACY_KEYWRAP=true/ENABLE_LEGACY_KEYWRAP=false/' /etc/redwood/worker.env
systemctl restart redwood-worker
```

Cara - Eng Sec: Also consider whether SLA credits apply if we force disruptive maintenance. Product/legal input needed.

Alice - SecOps: Legal flagged customer contract clause; credits possible only if outage > 30m for Dedicated. We'll confirm after dev ops mitigates.

Dave - Eng Runtime: FYI—if we push change to on-prem installer we must bump package SHA and sign new release. That will need SRE help to rotate images in staging.

Cara - Eng Sec: OK team — next steps summarized: emergency patch for hosted (48h), canary rollout plan, targeted customer outreach for Dedicated/private, advisory/backport within 14 days. I'll update triage board and close loop here. React with :thumbsup: when you ack.

Ben - Infra: :thumbsup:
Dave - Eng Runtime: :thumbsup:
Alice - SecOps: :thumbsup:
Emily - Product: :thumbsup:
Frank - Customer Success: :thumbsup:
